latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of draw-animal skill.

- Generates a simple text description for a requested animal picture.
- Supports specifying the animal type; defaults to "pig" if none is provided.
- Allows optional language selection (English or Chinese).
- Includes suggestions for common animals when prompting the user.
- Runs via a Python script using provided parameters.
